findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker could craft a payload that, when converted to an integer, triggers unexpected behavior or system commands.
findings.assumptions: The payload is attacker-controlled and directly used in a function that could lead to command execution.

findings.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
findings.trigger: An attacker could send a payload that causes an integer overflow, leading to undefined behavior.
findings.assumptions: The payload is attacker-controlled and directly converted to an integer without proper validation.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: An attacker could send a payload that, when converted to a string, could overflow a buffer.
findings.assumptions: The payload is attacker-controlled and directly used in a function that could lead to buffer overflow.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Argument Delimiters
findings.trigger: An attacker could craft a payload that, when converted to a string, could contain argument delimiters that are not properly neutralized.
findings.assumptions: The payload is attacker-controlled and directly used in a function that could lead to argument injection.
